data.narrative:
Modular Genetics operates in Biotech & Health, a sector represented by 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 7 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit. The company has raised $5.8M to date; its current stage and valuation remain undisclosed.

Peer-median valuation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the private peer set—none of the 7 sector peers met the narrow filtering criteria. Public-comp anchoring was similarly inapplicable because the target's revenue is not on file, a standard limitation for private companies. The public sector median price-to-sales multiple stands at 6.6x across the three public tickers, but without Modular Genetics' disclosed revenue, this multiple cannot be applied.

The absence of both a sufficiently matched private-peer cohort and disclosed target revenue prevents triangulated valuation at this time. Any credible range estimate would require either: disclosure of revenue or near-term revenue guidance, identification of additional same-stage or adjacent-stage private comparables with transparent financials, or progression to a later funding stage where investor disclosures become available. Capitalizing the $5.8M raised as a floor assumes typical early-stage dilution across future rounds but provides no ceiling absent additional financial or market data.
